text:
jamie: hey team, first week here — trying to run kubectl against our dev cluster but my contexts only show 'minikube' and a local docker-desktop. followed the onboarding doc but can't find the redwood contexts. who should I ping for kubeconfig / namespace access? :wave:
maya: welcome! :wave: can you paste the output of `kubectl config get-contexts` and `kubectl config view --minify`? also which team are you on so we can grant the right namespace role.
jamie: thanks! i'm on infra-platform. here's the get-contexts output:
```
CURRENT   NAME            CLUSTER         AUTHINFO        NAMESPACE
*         minikube        minikube        minikube        default
          docker-desktop  docker-desktop  docker-desktop  
```
and `kubectl config view --minify` just shows the minikube user.
maya: OK looks like your local kubeconfig didn't pull the company contexts. we use SSO-backed kubeconfigs via the idp connector. try running: `rwd-kube login --org redwood --env dev` (internal CLI). it will open the browser for SSO and then merge a new context named `redwood-dev-<cluster>-<user>`.
jamie: i don't have rwd-kube installed yet, getting a quick 404 when i try to curl the install script. is there a Homebrew tap or binary?
maya: yep, `brew install redwood/rwd/rwd-kube` or grab the binary from the devtools page (https://internal.redwood/devtools). if your machine is locked down DM me and i'll drop the binary in an S3 link.
devon: pinging infra. @maya we need to bind jamie to infra-platform ns. i'll create a RoleBinding granting 'edit' in `ns=infra-platform-dev` for the SSO group `okta:team-infra-platform`.
infra-bot: rolebinding "rb-jamie-infra-platform-dev" created in namespace "infra-platform-dev" for subject "okta:team-infra-platform:jamie" by devon at 2026-03-23T15:34:10Z
jamie: seeing new context after running `rwd-kube login` — context is `redwood-dev-gke-01-jamie`. i tried `kubectl get pods -n infra-platform-dev` and got `Error from server (Forbidden): pods is forbidden: User "okta|jamie" cannot list resource "pods" in API group "" in the namespace "infra-platform-dev"`.
maya: hmm infra-bot said rolebinding applied to team group; the forbidden implies your subject might be okta:user rather than group. devon — can you confirm the binding subject?
devon: my bad, i created the binding to the explicit user string. fixed to bind the Okta group instead. ran `kubectl apply -f -` (RoleBinding YAML) and deployed.
infra-bot: rolebinding "rb-team-infra-platform-dev" updated in namespace "infra-platform-dev" at 2026-03-23T15:40:56Z
jamie: retrying... `kubectl get pods -n infra-platform-dev` now works, and i can exec into a debug pod. thanks y'all! :tada:
maya: sweet — added a short note to the onboarding doc about using `rwd-kube` and the team group binding pattern. welcome aboard again! :rocket:
